scope: Every elected member (electedOf) whose dataset name the name rules of scripts/research/build-bios.py cannot match to exactly one member of that Knesset in the list's factions, plus reviewed links for candidates who were not elected. Each decision names the Knesset OData PersonID or leaves the candidate out; an optional basis replaces the generated basis text verbatim.

The 1999 results notice names the Shas list's rank 1 as the elected candidate who gave up the seat: YP 4757 p.3378 (data/raw/research/k15-results.pdf, PDF page 4), "הודעה בדבר התפטרות מועמדים לכנסת החמש-עשרה … אות הרשימה: שס … המועמד: מס' 1. אריה מכלוף דרעי, ברשימה זו התפטר ביום ד' בסיון התשנ"ט (19 במאי 1999)". The same name, given and middle names included, is Knesset member PersonID 2291 (Aryeh Machluf Deri), tied by ID to Shas rank 1 in 1996 (14-שס#1); no other member has it. Audit 13 Nov 2026 (c-famous-late-06).
